subject: Use of exp, log, etc with arrays and matrices

messages.author: 5f950c9713997d19
messages.subject: Use of exp, log, etc with arrays and matrices
parts:
Hi Group

I have been exploring the Eigen capabilities within TMB and have been able to get many of the functions to work. I am a bit stumped on the use of exp though. I have matrices and arrays for which I want to apply exp to each cell. 

As seen from the attached files, exp will work on matrices converted to arrays but does not seem to work on matrices or arrays directly. I tried all sorts of combos of array() and matrix() with exp, all to not avail. I see in the TMB documentation a matexp function but have not been able to get this to work. 

Any ideas?

Bob

messages.author: 90b303eef43fd993
messages.subject: RE: [TMB users] Use of exp, log, etc with arrays and matrices
parts:
TMB arrays are not Eigen arrays (see the array documentation):

- The TMB array class extends the eigen array with arbitrary dimension.
- Side-effect: You can't expect all TMB array methods to work as in R.

In your example:

DATA_ARRAY(a1);
array<Type> a1_exp = exp(a1);

The exp operator is not explicitly implemented for the TMB array. When applying exp to a1 the array is 'downgraded' to an Eigen array, i.e. the dimension attribute is lost. Fortunately, you get the error already at compile time. The workaround is to expand the code like this:

array<Type> a1_exp(a1.dim);
a1_exp = exp(a1);
